name: Tonghua Golden-Horse Pharmaceutical Industry Co,Ltd
summary: Tonghua Golden-Horse Pharmaceutical Industry Co,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceutical products in China. The company provides anti-tumor drugs, gynecological medications, medication for rheumatic bone pain, urological medications, heat-clearing and detoxifying drugs, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drugs, digestive medications, tonifying and restorative medicines, respiratory medication, diabetes medication, ENT medication, and pediatric medications. It also offers Xiaojin pills, Tian Ranshexiang Xiaojin pills, Xiaokechuan capsules, Jiuwei Qianghuo granules, Xiongdan powder, Bear Bile powder, and Wenweishu table…
